name: Tabularis
free_limit: Free, open-source Apache 2.0 SQL desktop workspace for Windows, macOS and Linux; built-in PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB and SQLite support, SQL notebooks, visual EXPLAIN and MCP server. No per-seat license fee.
watch_out: Local database client, not free database hosting. Connections require your own database; optional AI features use separately configured providers that may charge for API usage. Third-party plugins and infrastructure may have separate terms.
